description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error types across two language models, GPT4-o and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The chart is composed of six slices, representing categories of errors: Safety, Lack of Knowledge, Misinformation, Ethical Advice, and Clarification. For GPT4-o, the slices are colored light blue, light orange, light purple, pink, and light green, and represent Safety (16.7%), Lack of Knowledge (83.3%), Misinformation (38.4%), Ethical Advice (16.3%), and Clarification (14.0%) respectively. For Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, the slices are colored light blue, light orange, light purple, pink, and light green, and represent Misinformation (50.0%), Lack of Knowledge (75.0%), Clarification (25.0%), Lack of Knowledge (75.0%), and Safety (9.3%) respectively. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is included to identify each error type. The slices for each model appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
